set.body: Goal: provide opt-in real font measurement behind TextMetrics without making portable output depend on installed fonts. Keep TextMetrics.estimate as the deterministic shared default. Implement Java2D FontMetrics and Scala.js Canvas measureText adapters behind platform modules; measure the same font family and point size carried by GraphicParams; define missing-font fallback explicitly. Acceptance: no platform dependency in shared; explicit caller injection through LayoutPolicy; stable results for a fixed platform and font environment; tests for family and size propagation, fallback behavior, estimator comparison, and layout overflow. JavaFX may reuse a documented JVM provider or supply its own adapter.
